objective: A concept for a new lion variant, the Shadow Lion (legendary, twist speed; redesigned once as an ink-black lion with a bone mask and green glowing ribs), as a Blender model draft and render, with comparison sheets of the Lion and Sun Lion. Concept only: not wired into the game until its model is built and uploaded by the workflow. Also reworks the three lions' Blender models: cat legs (bent hock, thigh, elbow), shoulder and spine masses, cheeks and a nose bridge, painted fur markings, a clumped mane with a beard, and fur tufts.
acceptance_criteria: The Shadow Lion renders from four sides in the draft build and reads as a lion variant distinct from the Sun Lion
StationConfig and StationAssets are untouched until the model is baked, uploaded and SHANNON approves the variant
verification: Full Blender 5.2 build of creature_lion (12130 tris), creature_lion_sun (12420) and creature_lion_shadow (11984), all under the 12500 budget; four-view renders inspected. The manifest was restored after the test builds, so the game's models and StationAssets are unchanged. Not done: a build for the upload, the upload, how the new parts animate in the game, the StationConfig variant.
notes: Checkpoint for SHANNON: approve the Shadow Lion and the new lion shapes. The Lion's triangle budget went from 11000 to 12500 to match the variants. Hair parts get a small texture weight (0.2) so they do not crowd the atlas; the earlier detail pass without it made the body texture worse.
